field_definitions.zero_order_power_estimate: abs(tm)^2 + abs(te)^2 from zero-order TE/TM coefficients normalized to the incident TM mode; a modal estimate, not integrated flux
field_definitions.total_transmitted_power_ratio: integrated transmitted z-directed power divided by incident power
field_definitions.bare_reference_transmission_ratio: pillar transmission-plane flux divided by bare-substrate transmitted flux; may exceed one without violating energy conservation
field_definitions.bare_reference_total_transmission: bare-substrate transmitted flux divided by incident flux
field_definitions.reflectance: backward power at the input monitor divided by incident flux, after incident-field subtraction
field_definitions.power_balance_error: total_transmitted_power_ratio + reflectance - 1 for these lossless materials; use as a numerical-convergence diagnostic
field_definitions.incident_transmission_plane_flux: raw integrated z-directed Poynting flux from the no-structure incident-field normalization run
field_definitions.reference_transmission_plane_flux: raw integrated z-directed Poynting flux for the bare reference
field_definitions.pillar_transmission_plane_flux: raw integrated z-directed Poynting flux for the pillar simulation
field_definitions.zero_order_tm_magnitude: magnitude of the normalized zero-order TM coefficient
field_definitions.zero_order_tm_phase_deg: phase of the normalized zero-order TM coefficient, in degrees from 0 to 360
